text:
12, 10, 8, and then 20 means:
- 12 reps in the first set
- 10 reps in the second set
- 8 reps in the third set
- 20 reps in the last set
The 12 is mid-weight, the 10 is a little bit heavier, and the 8 is the heaviest weight that you're going to use. You drop back to the 20 for a light-weight, high-rep set. The 10 and 10 is unilateral, so I made that mistake. 10 and 10 means 10 on each arm. If I put it bilateral on purpose, then it would be a set of 10 and then another set of 10.
